title: Revit governed tag and parameter mapping
test_intent: Determine whether applicable Revit tags use approved tag families and display governed parameters without substituting manual text for required data-driven fields.

applicability.applies_when: The tested model contains tags or symbols covered by a governed tag/parameter mapping.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No governed tag/parameter mapping applies to the tested scope.

required_evidence: inventory of applicable tag instances and family/type identities
observed label parameter references for governed tag fields
approved exception records where project-specific deviations apply

result_logic.pass: Applicable tags use approved families or approved exceptions and each governed displayed data field resolves to the expected governed parameter without unapproved manual-text substitution.
result_logic.fail: An applicable tag uses an unapproved family, references the wrong parameter, or substitutes manual/free text for a governed data field where an approved mapping is available.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed tag/parameter mapping applies to the tested scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The required tag-family profile, mapping, or parameter identity is unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Derived from Appendix E source requirements for controlled tag families, parameter-driven content, and schedule alignment.
